verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that ScrapingBee, a scraping SaaS rather than an agent, documents an official MCP server at a first-party hosted endpoint, so the axis applies and the product itself provides the capability. The evidence is a single probe line, with no detail on exposed tools, authentication, transport or client setup. Missing for 10: documentation of MCP tools and capabilities, connection and auth instructions for agent clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://mcp.scrapingbee.com/
